DOCX works via pandoc. Collabora not available (expected in this env since LLM/Collabora are external services the user provides).

The installation is complete and successful. The core software is installed, running, and verified. Optional external services (LLM, Collabora, Whisper, embedding) are not part of the install; they're backends the operator points to.

Let me note that the guide says version 0.7.0 but actual is 0.9.0 - minor doc discrepancy, not a failure.

Let me verify the container is still up and healthy, and clean up test artifacts. Actually I should keep the deployment running. Let me confirm final state.

Let me also double check whether ffmpeg missing matters - the repo Dockerfile includes ffmpeg but the published image doesn't. The guide's table lists video requires ffmpeg. This is a minor discrepancy but the published image is what the guide says to use. Not a failure of installation.

Let me confirm final status and clean up sample files maybe. I'll leave the compose deployment running as the access point. Remove temp test files in /tmp (outside workspace, fine). The tika.yml and taki-config.yaml in /workspace are deliverables.

Let me do a final state check.
